alternatives.label: Sunlit Verandah
alternatives.reason: Warm terracotta and saffron on a cream verandah palette with deep brown text at high contrast gives HaqPath a calm, human, public-service feel that is clearly distinct from banking or corporate dashboards, while the humanist Noto Sans and Mukta type stays legible for first-time, mobile-first users.

alternatives.label: Ledger of Hope
alternatives.reason: A cool paper-white ground, ink-navy structure, and marigold reserved for deadlines and status give HaqPath an official, ledger-like calm that makes verified rules feel checkable rather than promotional.

alternatives.label: Monsoon Courtyard
alternatives.reason: Muted sage and clay tones on a warm off-white ground give a calm, human public-service feel rather than a corporate banking look, while warm charcoal text and deep sage primary keep contrast above WCAG AA for low-literacy and low-light reading on small screens.

alternatives.label: Classroom Lantern
alternatives.reason: Deep indigo header bands with a lantern-yellow highlight and cream content panels give strong figure-ground contrast and a calm, warm, student-friendly public-service feel that is clearly distinct from a banking dashboard.
